tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.fil.en: Places the selected block into empty air in the selection, %s MRU each
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.fil.zh: 只往选区里的空气格放选定方块，每格 %s MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.cle.en: Removes every block in the selection, %s MRU each
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.cle.zh: 清除选区里所有的方块，每格 %s MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.cle.en: Removes only blocks matching the selected block, %s MRU each
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.cle.zh: 只清除选区里和选定方块相同的方块，每格 %s MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.cle.en: Removes every block except the selected one, %s MRU each
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.cle.zh: 清除选区里选定方块以外的方块，每格 %s MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.rep.en: Fills air with the selected block (%s MRU each) and swaps every other block for it (%s MRU each)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.mode.rep.zh: 空气格放上选定方块（每格 %s MRU），其它方块换成它（每格 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.use_bloc.en: Right-click two blocks to set the corners; sneak + right-click a block to select it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.use_bloc.zh: 右键两个方块设两个角；潜行右键一个方块把它选定

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.use_air.en: Right-click the air to start; sneak + right-click the air to stop or clear the points
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.use_air.zh: 对空气右键开工；潜行对空气右键停下或清掉两个点

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.cycle.en: Put it alone in a crafting grid to switch modes (MRU and points are kept)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.cycle.zh: 单独放进工作台换模式（MRU 和两个点都留着）

message.essentialcraft5.builder.too_far.en: [Building Wand] The points are too far apart (%s), max %s!
message.essentialcraft5.builder.too_far.zh: [创世神之杖] 两点距离 %s 超出上限 %s！

message.essentialcraft5.builder.both_set.en: [Building Wand] Both points are already set! Sneak + right-click the air to reset.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.both_set.zh: [创世神之杖] 两个点都已设置！潜行对空气右键可重置

message.essentialcraft5.builder.block.zh: [创世神之杖] 方块已设为：%s

message.essentialcraft5.builder.reset.zh: [创世神之杖] 已重置两个点！

message.essentialcraft5.builder.denied.zh: [创世神之杖] 已有 %s 格没有权限，停下了：框选时避开别人的领地。完成了 %s 格

message.essentialcraft5.builder.denied_s.en: [Building Wand] %s blocks in a row were refused, stopped: you may not build here. %s blocks done.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.denied_s.zh: [创世神之杖] 连续 %s 格被拒，已停工：此处不允许你施工。完成了 %s 格

message.essentialcraft5.builder.too_big.en: [Building Wand] The selection would have %s blocks, max %s!
message.essentialcraft5.builder.too_big.zh: [创世神之杖] 选区有 %s 格，超出上限 %s 格！

message.essentialcraft5.builder.no_point.zh: [创世神之杖] 先设好两个点

message.essentialcraft5.builder.no_block.en: [Building Wand] Sneak + right-click a block to select it first.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.no_block.zh: [创世神之杖] 先潜行右键一个方块，把它选定

message.essentialcraft5.builder.other_di.en: [Building Wand] The points are in another dimension.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.other_di.zh: [创世神之杖] 两个点不在这个维度

message.essentialcraft5.builder.out_of_r.en: [Building Wand] Too far from the selection (stay within %s blocks).
message.essentialcraft5.builder.out_of_r.zh: [创世神之杖] 离选区太远了（要在 %s 格以内）

message.essentialcraft5.builder.not_load.en: [Building Wand] Part of the selection isn't loaded.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.not_load.zh: [创世神之杖] 选区有一部分还没加载

message.essentialcraft5.builder.aim_uncl.en: [Building Wand] That face can't be made out clearly from here.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.aim_uncl.zh: [创世神之杖] 看不清那一面

message.essentialcraft5.builder.busy.en: [Building Wand] A job is in progress. Sneak + right-click the air to stop.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.busy.zh: [创世神之杖] 正在施工，潜行对空气右键可以停下

message.essentialcraft5.builder.cannot_b.en: [Building Wand] You can't change blocks right now.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.cannot_b.zh: [创世神之杖] 现在不能改动方块

message.essentialcraft5.builder.started.zh: [创世神之杖] 开工，选区共 %s 格……

message.essentialcraft5.builder.stopped.zh: [创世神之杖] 已停下，完成了 %s 格

message.essentialcraft5.builder.out_of_m.zh: [创世神之杖] %s 用完了，完成了 %s 格

message.essentialcraft5.builder.no_mru.en: [Building Wand] Not enough MRU (%s needed). %s blocks done.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.no_mru.zh: [创世神之杖] MRU 不够（要 %s），完成了 %s 格

message.essentialcraft5.builder.interrup.zh: [创世神之杖] 中断了：要一直拿着魔杖、留在 %s 格以内。完成了 %s 格

message.essentialcraft5.builder.queued.zh: [创世神之杖] 已排队，前面还有 %s 个

message.essentialcraft5.builder.queued_s.en: [Building Wand] Queued; waiting for a free slot.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.queued_s.zh: [创世神之杖] 已排队，等空出名额

message.essentialcraft5.builder.disabled.en: [Building Wand] The wand doesn't work in this dimension.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.disabled.zh: [创世神之杖] 这个维度里不能使用魔杖

message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.en: [Building Wand] Material for only %s of %s blocks. Click again within 3 seconds to start anyway.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.zh: [创世神之杖] 材料只够 %s / %s 格，3 秒内再点一次照样开工

message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.en: [Building Wand] %s MRU available, %s needed. Click again within 3 seconds to start anyway.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.zh: [创世神之杖] 可用 MRU %s，这一单要 %s，3 秒内再点一次照样开工

message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.en: [Building Wand] %s blocks to change. Click again within 3 seconds to start.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.zh: [创世神之杖] 要改动 %s 格，3 秒内再点一次开工

message.essentialcraft5.builder.pre_prob.en: [Building Wand] About %s%% of this area is protected from you; those blocks will be skipped.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.pre_prob.zh: [创世神之杖] 这片范围约有 %s%% 你动不了，那部分会跳过

message.essentialcraft5.builder.paused_m.en: [Building Wand] Out of %s; carry more and building resumes (%s s left).
message.essentialcraft5.builder.paused_m.zh: [创世神之杖] %s 用完了，补到身上就接着施工（还剩 %s 秒）

message.essentialcraft5.builder.paused_m.en: [Building Wand] Not enough MRU (%s needed); recharge and building resumes (%s s left).
message.essentialcraft5.builder.paused_m.zh: [创世神之杖] MRU 不够（要 %s），补上就接着施工（还剩 %s 秒）

message.essentialcraft5.builder.broken_o.en: %s blocks were removed but not replaced: no permission to place there.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.broken_o.zh: %s 格只拆未放：原方块已拆除，但没有放置权限

message.essentialcraft5.builder.queued_o.en: [Building Wand] Queued; it will start once your current job is done.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.queued_o.zh: [创世神之杖] 已排队，当前这一单完成后开工

message.essentialcraft5.builder.unloaded.zh: %s 格所在的区块没加载，跳过了

message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_sta.zh: [创世神之杖] 撤销中，共 %s 格……

message.essentialcraft5.builder.undone.zh: [创世神之杖] 已撤销：收回 %s 格并退还材料；%s 格已经变了，没有动

message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_non.en: [Building Wand] Nothing to undo. Only placements can be undone; clearing can't.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_non.zh: [创世神之杖] 没有能撤销的。只能撤销放置，清除的结果不能撤销

message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_cle.zh: [创世神之杖] 上一次是清除，清除的结果无法撤销

message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_exp.en: [Building Wand] The last placement is too old or in another dimension.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_exp.zh: [创世神之杖] 上一次放置已经过了时限，或者不在这个维度

message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_off.en: [Building Wand] Undo is turned off on this server.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_off.zh: [创世神之杖] 这个服务器关掉了撤销

message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_hin.en: [Building Wand] Nothing running. Hold the wand key and right-click to undo the last placement.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.undo_hin.zh: [创世神之杖] 没有在施工。按住魔杖键再右键，可以撤销上一次放置

message.essentialcraft5.builder.surveyin.en: [Building Wand] Still measuring. Wait a moment, or sneak + right-click the air to stop.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.surveyin.zh: [创世神之杖] 还在测量，请稍等；潜行对空气右键可以停下

message.essentialcraft5.builder.survey_s.zh: [创世神之杖] 已停止测量

message.essentialcraft5.builder.survey_i.en: [Building Wand] Measuring interrupted: keep holding the wand on Surface and stay within %s blocks.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.survey_i.zh: [创世神之杖] 测量中断：须一直手持沿面形状的魔杖，并留在 %s 格以内

message.essentialcraft5.builder.survey_c.zh: [创世神之杖] 测量已取消

message.essentialcraft5.builder.face_no_.en: [Building Wand] Surface needs a block face to follow; aim at a block.

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.use_plan.zh: 右键方块或空气开工，清除类模式和全部替换从点中的方块本身算起；潜行右键方块把它选定，潜行对空气右键停下

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.use_face.en: Right-click a block face to work on the layer of connected blocks of that kind that shares the clicked face: Fill covers that face, the Remove modes and Replace All act on the blocks themselves; sneak + right-click a block to select it, the air to stop
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.use_face.zh: 右键方块的一个面，作用于点中那一面所在的一层相连同种方块：填充铺在这一面外侧，清除类模式和全部替换处理这些方块本身；潜行右键方块把它选定，潜行对空气右键停下

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.wand_key.en: Tap %s to open the Blueprint Table; hold it and scroll to resize, or right-click to undo
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.wand_key.zh: 单按%s打开蓝图台；按住它滚动滚轮调整尺寸、右键撤销

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.wand_key.zh: 单按%s打开蓝图台；按住它右键撤销上一次放置

message.essentialcraft5.builder.points_n.zh: [创世神之杖] 两点形状的大小由两个角决定；单按%s打开蓝图台可切换到铺面、直线或竖墙

hud.essentialcraft5.builder.creative.zh: 创造模式：不消耗材料和 MRU

hud.essentialcraft5.builder.paused_mru.en: Not enough MRU; recharge to continue (%s s left)
hud.essentialcraft5.builder.paused_mru.zh: MRU 不足，补充后继续施工（剩 %s 秒）

hud.essentialcraft5.builder.queued.zh: 排队中，前面还有 %s 个

item.essentialcraft5.magical_builder_cle.en: Ascended Magical Building Wand (Remove All But Selected)
item.essentialcraft5.magical_builder_cle.zh: 创世神之杖·升格（清除选定以外）

item.essentialcraft5.magical_builder_rep.zh: 创世神之杖·升格（全部替换）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.1.en: Tier 1: up to %s blocks at once, planes and lines up to %s long, works within %s blocks
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.1.zh: 一阶：一次至多 %s 格，铺面、直线边长至多 %s 格，施工距离 %s 格

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.2.en: Tier 2: up to %s blocks at once, planes, lines and walls up to %s long, works within %s blocks
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.2.zh: 二阶：一次至多 %s 格，铺面、直线、竖墙边长至多 %s 格，施工距离 %s 格

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.3.en: Tier 3: up to %s blocks at once, planes, lines and walls up to %s long, works within %s blocks
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.3.zh: 三阶：一次至多 %s 格，铺面、直线、竖墙边长至多 %s 格，施工距离 %s 格

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.pav.en: Fill mode only; shapes are limited to two points, plane and line
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.pav.zh: 仅有填充模式；形状限两点、铺面、直线

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.und.en: Can undo the last %s placements, one at a time
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.tier.und.zh: 可依次撤销最近 %s 次放置

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.paver_up.en: Use it in place of a whitelist filter in the Magical Building Wand recipe to upgrade it to tier 2 (MRU, selected block and settings are kept)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder.paver_up.zh: 在创世神之杖的配方中代替一个白名单过滤器，可升为二阶（MRU、选定方块与设置一并保留）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.r.en: Blocks per job ×%s, plane and line sides ×%s (rounded down, within the server limit)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.r.zh: 一次可改动的格数 ×%s，铺面、直线的边长 ×%s（向下取整，不超过服务器设定的上限）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.h.en: Blocks placed, removed or swapped per tick ×%s (server-wide limits still apply)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.h.zh: 每刻至多放置、拆除、替换的格数 ×%s（仍受全服每刻总量的限制）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.e.zh: 每格消耗的 MRU ×%s（向下取整）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.r.en: Work range +%s blocks; Plane, Wall and Surface can be aimed as far as the work range
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.r.zh: 施工距离增加 %s 格，铺面、竖墙、沿面的瞄准距离随之增加

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.s.zh: 拆除所得的物品先放入身上的背包类容器，放不下再放入背包，仍放不下则掉在脚下；丢弃清单中的物品拆下后直接舍弃

tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.i.en: Combine with a Magical Building Wand or Paving Wand in a crafting table to fit it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.builder_module.i.zh: 在工作台中与创世神之杖或铺设魔杖合在一起即可装上

message.essentialcraft5.builder.module_b.en: Modules can't be changed while the wand is working
message.essentialcraft5.builder.module_b.zh: 魔杖施工期间不能拆装模块

message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.en: [Building Wand] Not enough of every mixed block (on hand / needed): %s. Click again within 3 seconds to start anyway.
message.essentialcraft5.builder.confirm_.zh: [创世神之杖] 混铺的材料不足（持有 / 需要）：%s，3 秒内再点一次照样开工

message.essentialcraft5.builder.discard_.zh: 已设置丢弃清单，共 %s 项

message.essentialcraft5.builder.settings.en: [Building Wand] A job is in progress; stop it before changing the mix table or discard list
message.essentialcraft5.builder.settings.zh: [创世神之杖] 正在施工，须先停下才能修改混铺表和丢弃清单

hud.essentialcraft5.builder.mix_material.en: Mixing %s kinds: %s on hand (%s in containers)
hud.essentialcraft5.builder.mix_material.zh: 混铺 %s 种，持有 %s（其中容器里 %s）

message.essentialcraft5.builder.panel_bu.en: [Building Wand] A job is in progress; stop it before changing settings
message.essentialcraft5.builder.panel_bu.zh: [创世神之杖] 正在施工，须先停下才能修改设置

message.essentialcraft5.builder.module_o.zh: [创世神之杖] 已停用%s，它仍占用一个槽位

gui.essentialcraft5.builder_panel.locked.en: Job in progress; stop it to make changes
gui.essentialcraft5.builder_panel.locked.zh: 正在施工，须先停下才能修改

gui.essentialcraft5.builder_panel.too_sm.en: The window is too small for the Blueprint Table. Enlarge the window or lower the GUI scale
gui.essentialcraft5.builder_panel.too_sm.zh: 窗口太小，无法显示蓝图台。请放大窗口或调小界面尺寸

gui.essentialcraft5.builder_panel.shape_.zh: 右键两个方块定下两个对角，作用于两角之间的整个长方体

gui.essentialcraft5.builder_panel.shape_.zh: 以准星对准的方块为中心铺设一片水平面，可调整边长与长度

gui.essentialcraft5.builder_panel.shape_.zh: 沿面朝方向延伸一条直线，填充从对准那一面的外侧起，清除类模式和全部替换从对准的方块本身起
